name: Omakill
author: hangovers
description: Kill any app or process from SUPER+SPACE → Kill or the skull bar button. Three fast actions with zero new daemons: 1) Click to kill (xkill-style pointer target with hint toast), 2) Window picker (clean native selection by app title/PID, no raw addresses), 3) Process picker (live /proc CPU/MEM top-200 with confirm, PID 1/self guards, pidfd-pinned TERM→KILL). Built exclusively for Omarchy using stock system tools.

barWidget.description: Kill menu with click-to-kill, window, and process pickers.
